text:
Eli: Heads up — planning to evolve console telemetry event shape. We want to add a small route_context blob and promote event_type values to a v2 namespace (e.g., console_action -> console_event_v2). Need to coordinate DB migration, SDKs, pipelines, and rollout. Thoughts?
Carmen: +1 on additive only. We must avoid breaking existing enum constraints in postgres consumers. If event_type is an enum column today, we need a migration path.
Tara: For safety I suggest: keep event_type as-is, add event_type_v2 text (nullable) and route_context jsonb (nullable). Consumers can migrate to v2 gradually. Performance impact? jsonb might hurt scans.
Vlad: Agree with incremental. Prefer extracting high-cardinality fields into thin columns rather than a big blob. Proposed minimal columns: route_id text, route_latency_ms int, route_context jsonb (for extras). Example SQL:
```sql
ALTER TABLE telemetry.events
  ADD COLUMN event_type_v2 text,
  ADD COLUMN route_id text,
  ADD COLUMN route_latency_ms int,
  ADD COLUMN route_context jsonb;
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS telemetry_events_route_id_idx ON telemetry.events(route_id);
```
This keeps common filters fast and still stores full context.
infra-bot: migration-runner: created migration job 2026-03-18T14:05Z (scheduled for canary).
Eli: Plan sketch: 1) deploy above nullable cols to prod (no table rewrites), 2) release SDKs to write both event_type and event_type_v2 for a period, 3) push a streaming mapping in ETL to populate event_type_v2 for older rows if missing, 4) run backfill for 90 days for route columns, 5) after 3 months and consumer readiness, drop old enum constraint / columns.
Carmen: Backfill considerations — chunking, memory usage. The backfill job must respect tenant rate limits and skip oversized payloads. We should also fail-fast on malformed JSON.
Tara: Can we gate by tenant via feature flags? We could canary 10% of active tenants (routing-policy) then expand. That avoids global load spikes.
Vlad: Yes — I'll wire the migration/backfill to our rollout service. Also will add a small table telemetry.migration_progress(tenant_id, window_start, window_end, last_offset) so jobs are resumable.
Eli: Metrics and dashboards to watch: events ingestion lag, p99 query latency on telemetry.events, disk growth per partition, and kafka downstream consumer lag for analytics. We'll need dashboard panels that split v1 vs v2 counts.
Carmen: Note: analytics team uses event_type for joins in their materialized views. We should ship a streaming compatibility layer in the ETL to map v2->v1 canonical values until views are rebuilt.
Tara: I'll open two tickets: one for SDKs (emit both fields + docs), one for console UI to show route_context in debug mode only.
Vlad: I'll own DB migration and index rollout. Targeting low-traffic window next Wed. I'll also add an alert: telemetry.events.table_growth_warn when partition > X GB in 24h.
Eli: For safety add integration tests: 1) ingestion writes both fields, 2) analytics pipeline can handle mixed v1/v2, 3) backfill job resumes after failures.
Carmen: Also remember quota impact — route_context increases event size. We should run a simulation on last week's sample to estimate token/storage impact and update quota docs.
Vlad: Will run a sampling job and post numbers in this thread.
Eli: Ok — next steps: Tara creates SDK PR, Carmen coordinates ETL mapping, Vlad schedules migration window and backfill run, I'll update runbook and dashboards.
Tara: Starting SDK PR today, will tag @Carmen for integration tests.
Vlad: Scheduling maintenance + will post exact times.
infra-bot: Note: deployment-policy check passed for additive column migration.
Eli: Thanks all — if no blockers I'll queue the migration for canary next Wed. :thumbsup:
